Server-Sent Events. `delta` frames carry the incremental text and `done` closes with the token and cost accounting. A `metering_failed` frame means the RESPONSE went out but the cost was not accounted for — the failure shows up instead of disappearing. If the budget is exceeded with `policy=block`, the stream carries `error` and no `delta`.
